scope: Additional Android visual decisions after corrected input gate. Original primary manual/grades retained. Identical PNG sequences are inspected once and SHA-bound to each actual observation; no new discoveries receive own-review detection credit.

decisions.reason: Reviewed original state PNGs (or byte-identical original PNG sequences bound in android-visual-index.json) at native logical width. Queue, inspector, selected markers, stacked controls, summary and all four notes are readable, ordered and free of component clipping/overlap. Offscreen portions of the parent ScrollView are not clipping. PASS for the captured visual composition: the component paints its specified white / dark-purple canvas and preserves visible palette roles, selected/disabled appearance, readable wrapping and note hierarchy. Parent outer padding and observer sentinel are outside component scope. Visual P does not supply exact unasserted fonts/padding or supersede native/callback checks. Original loaded/replaced native interval union is complete.
